scope: conditional steady-state DCM model; inherited peak bound and same11W maximum bus power; not startup/fault/transient or actual waveform
derivation: Ip_rms^2=f*Ip^2*ton/3; Pmag=f*Lp*Ip^2/2; ton=Lp*Ip/V. Therefore <=2*Pmag*Ip/(3*Vmin). Assumes ideal linear fully-reset triangular magnetizing current, bounded power and peak.
triangle_note: Ic=Ibridge-Ip; RMS(Ic)<=RMS(Ibridge)+RMS(Ip), combining separate maxima conservatively. Averaged line-current model is not a proven switching-current bound.
conclusion: This conservative screen does not establish15uF ripple acceptance; it does not prove actual capacitor fails. Need actual/sufficiently bounded current spectrum, thermal/ripple assessment before accepting input stage. No capacitance ECO selected.
transformer_propagation: Measured/guaranteed hot winding resistances and AC/core/aux loss must be propagated through real regulation, auxiliary takeover and thermal model; ideal transformer sweeps are not silently upgraded to physical results.
